headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way on the mound. Cole pitched 7.0 innings, securing the win for the Yankees.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Cooper Pratt, a shortstop for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays, Cole Wilcox of the Seattle Mariners, Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins, Slade Cecconi of the Cleveland Guardians, Chris Murphy of the Chicago White Sox, and Joey Bart of the Chicago White Sox.

There have been several trades and roster movements in the MLB. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched performance.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Brewers Place Cooper Pratt on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers shortstop Cooper Pratt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Pratt's status is currently uncertain as he begins his recovery.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster following the trade.
